verdict.rationale: LiteLLM Proxy ships an official MCP Gateway with a fixed endpoint that agents can connect to for tool access, controllable by key/team, plus a UI to register MCP servers and REST endpoints (/mcp-rest/tools/list, /mcp-rest/tools/call) to invoke tools directly. This is first-party documented functionality directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that agents (e.g. Cursor, Claude) successfully connect via this MCP endpoint, and no community evidence corroborating real-world usage of the MCP gateway specifically.
